xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4826: fix(models): OpenAI and Anthropic catalog refresh (prices, gpt-6-rosalind, sonnet-4-5 retirement, 1M context)

plan.title: fix(models): OpenAI and Anthropic catalog refresh (prices, gpt-6-rosalind, sonnet-4-5 retirement, 1M context)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The operator split the 2026-11 catalog audit into three provider-grouped sibling issues (PAN-4825/4826/4827) so their PRs edit disjoint entries in the same shared catalog files; splitting the OpenAI+Anthropic slice further would put more PRs on those same files and multiply conflicts. Each item is already a small independent slice with its own tests.

narratives.Problem: The OpenAI and Anthropic catalog has drifted from the official pages (checked 2026-11-02). cost.ts still prices gpt-5.6-sol at $5/$30, terra at $2.50/$15, luna at $1/$6 and gpt-5.2 at $1.25/$10. Several capability blends are wrong (gpt-5.5 $3/$18, gpt-5.5-pro $18/$220, gpt-5.4-mini 1.0, gpt-5.2 window 200K vs 400K). gpt-6-rosalind and gpt-6-astra-law are missing. claude-sonnet-4-5 retires on 2026-11-30 but is still in PROVIDERS.anthropic.models.
narratives.Proposal: Reprice in place from the official pricing page (cost rows, capability blends, picker badges, catalog fixture). Register gpt-6-rosalind and gpt-6-astra-law as opt-in, API-key-only, unranked domain models on the gpt-6.1-terra Codex route (272K pin, no CLIProxy, no Codex floor because they cannot be measured). Remove claude-sonnet-4-5 from PROVIDERS.anthropic.models only, keeping its migration to claude-sonnet-4-6 and its historical rows. Keep Opus 4.6/Sonnet 4.6 at the 200K window Claude Code actually launches them with, and record why. Update harnesses.mdx, MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md, USAGE.md and TESTING-PROVIDERS.md. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4826.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No [1m] ModelIds for claude-opus-4-6 or claude-sonnet-4-6, and no change to their 200000 contextWindow
- No change to the claude-sonnet-4-5 MODEL_DEPRECATIONS target (stays claude-sonnet-4-6)
- No tierModels or haikuModel change for any provider
- No change to operator-retired MODEL_DEPRECATIONS rows
- No CODEX_MODEL_MINIMUM_VERSIONS row, no GPT_56_MODELS membership, no CLIProxy route for gpt-6-rosalind or gpt-6-astra-law
- No edit to src/lib/runtimes/codex.ts
- No modeling of >272K long-context price tiers in cost.ts
- No edits to providers other than OpenAI and Anthropic (PAN-4825, PAN-4827 own them)
- No changelog.mdx edit
- No new lines in src/lib/model-capabilities.ts or src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts, and no file-size allowlist raise
- No hardcoded model fallback

autoDecisions.summary: Keep claude-opus-4-6 and claude-sonnet-4-6 at contextWindow 200000 instead of raising to 1M (issue AC #4 not met)
autoDecisions.rationale: code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config says Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 reach 1M only through the plan-gated [1m] variant; Overdeck launches the bare ids, and contextWindow drives the context meter and Deacon 85% compaction, so 1M would reproduce PAN-3057. Issue rule 1: the official page wins; the PR body records it.

Issue AC #3 names this target explicitly, claude-sonnet-4-6 is Active until at least 2027-02-17, and existing tests assert it. Anthropic recommends claude-sonnet-5-5; the PR body notes the difference.
The issue says to add it only if it appears on the official pricing page; it does ($10/$1/$50, promotional through 2026-12-31).

autoDecisions.summary: No Codex floor for the new ids
autoDecisions.rationale: Neither id is in the Codex 0.159.0 ChatGPT-sign-in catalog (codex debug models, 2026-11-02) and access is trusted-access only, so a floor cannot be measured; existing floors are all measured.

autoDecisions.summary: gpt-5.6-sol priced at the promotional $4/$20/$0.40 with a dated comment
autoDecisions.rationale: No post-promo rate is published on the pricing page; the issue says to use $4/$20 with a dated comment in that case.

autoDecisions.summary: Domain models get unranked skills (0) and no minTier/maxOutputTokens
autoDecisions.rationale: No benchmarks or limits are published (model pages 404); the Muse precedent marks unbenchmarked models unranked, and omitted minTier means API-key only, matching trusted-access availability.

autoDecisions.summary: gpt-5.2 gains its official cached rate and 400K window; the no-cache-pricing test moves to gpt-5.5-pro
autoDecisions.rationale: The official page lists $0.175 cached and a 400,000 window; gpt-5.5-pro has no cached rate listed, so it keeps the test meaningful.
